title: Patents for a memory-erasing 'neuralizer' technology
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Patents for a memory-erasing 'neuralizer' technology, about unspecified at US Patent Office, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, I kind of learned some stuff on that and I saw the patents on it.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he learned about a technology that erases memories, nicknamed a "neuralizer" after the device in the movies. He says he has seen US patents for it. If true, it would mean such a tool exists on paper in official records.
